newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares maintain rally, Hansapank leads.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares maintain rally, Hansapank leads.

text.p: The Estonian stock market maintained its steady rise on Thursday, with half its volume accounted for by leading bank Hansapank.
Hansapank turned over 23.9 million kroons from overall main list volume of 46.6 million kroons and the index climbed by 1.73 percent to 157.83. Hansapank closed at 162 kroons versus 158.10.
The second biggest bank, Estonian Savings Bank, had volume of seven million kroons and closed at 65.25 kroons versus 66.
Some five million kroons worth of Forekspank shares changed hands and it surged higher to close at 116.25 kroons versus 112.80.
Drug producer Tallinn Pharmaceutical had volume of five million kroons and closed up at 108 kroons versus 94. The company said earlier it expects a net profit this year of 29.5 million kroons.
The free market turned over some 5.8 million kroons and the Norma plastics maker was the most traded share.
It had volume of 1.8 million kroons and closed at 36.10 kroons versus 35.90.
